name: Anukalp Ranjan
hero_subline: Now I make sure your videos sound as good as they look.
about_paragraph_1: I'm Anukalp Ranjan, an 18-year-old video editor and content creator. I mainly edit talking-head and podcast-style content — long-form for YouTube and short-form for Instagram Reels and equivalent platforms — with AI avatar and gen AI ad film work as an additional skill set.
about_paragraph_2: Currently building at the intersection of storytelling and sound. I focus on work that actually stops people mid-scroll.
about_paragraph_3: I don't disappear mid-project. Fast turnarounds, honest updates, and I stick around after the first edit — that's the whole point.

steps.title: Share your vision
steps.description: Drop references, tell me what you're picturing.

steps.title: I study what you love
steps.description: I go through your existing content — specifically the pieces you love most — to learn what's already working for you.

steps.title: Sample reels
steps.description: I cut 2 sample reels before any commitment, so we calibrate together before money or time is on the line.

steps.title: We talk it through
steps.description: An honest conversation about what worked and what didn't. Only then do we discuss a retainer or ongoing work.

second_self_mention.text: For bigger or ongoing needs, there's a studio version of this.

seo.site_title: Anukalp Ranjan — Video Editor & Content Creator
seo.meta_description: Video editor and content creator based in Bangalore, specializing in talking-head and podcast editing, with AI avatar and gen AI ad film work as additional skills.

closing_note: Open to freelance projects, full-time roles, and creative collaborations.
